name: mobius-connect
description: Browse indexed AI coding sessions and inspect recorded session lineage in a local Möbius vault.

interface.shortDescription: Browse indexed coding sessions and their recorded lineage.
interface.longDescription: List locally indexed Codex and Claude Code sessions and inspect recorded handoff links. The Windows preview uses the mobius-connect executable and a local Möbius vault.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $mobius-memory to list indexed sessions and show the recorded lineage for the session I select.
